features.title: 核心功能

hump.title: 驼峰纵断面设计

tooltip.pure:
基本阻力能高
h0 = (r0,溜 · L溜 + r0,场 · L场) / 1000
r0 = 2.439 + (0.00008·Q − 0.01743)·t − 0.015·Q + 0.00017·t² + 0.1·v + n·1.65·σ + (1−k)·0.39
σ = 0.602 − (0.0012 + 0.00002·Q)·t − 0.003·Q + 0.00002·t²
Q = {Q} t；t = {temp} °C；n = {n}（车型参数）；v溜 = {vSlope} m/s（k=0）；v场 = {vYard} m/s（k=1）；r0,溜 = {r0Slope} N/kN；r0,场 = {r0Yard} N/kN；L溜 = {lSlope} m；L场 = {lYard} m
tooltip.air:
风阻力能高
hw = (rw,溜 · L溜 + rw,场 · L场) / 1000
rw = (ρ · f · cx1/cx0) / (2 · Q · cos²α) · (v + ξ · v风 · cosβ)²
α = arctan((v风 · sinβ) / (v + ξ · v风 · cosβ))
Q = {Q} t；ρ = {rho} kg·s²/m⁴；f = {f} m²；v风 = {vWind} m/s；ξ = {xi}；β = 0°；α = 0°；cx1/cx0 = 1；v溜 = {vSlope} m/s；v场 = {vYard} m/s；rw,溜 = {rwSlope} N/kN；rw,场 = {rwYard} N/kN；L溜 = {lSlope} m；L场 = {lYard} m
tooltip.switch:
道岔阻力能高
hs = Es / 1000
Es = 24·N逆 + 12·(N顺 + N菱) + 48·N交分
N逆 = {nReverse}；N顺 = {nForward}；N菱 = {nDiamond}；N交分 = {nSlip}；Es = {Es} N·m/kN
tooltip.curve:
曲线阻力能高
hc = Ec / 1000
Ec = 8 · θ总 = 8 · (θ曲 + θ岔)
θ曲 = {pureCurve} °（曲线转角）；θ岔 = {switchCurve} °（道岔转角）；θ总 = {totalCurve} °；Ec = {Ec} N·m/kN
